words.gloss: the state of not being born again

literal: When desiring, one should desire non-birth; and that, by desiring desirelessness, will come.
translation: If one must desire anything, let it be the state of not being born again; and that state of non-birth will be attained by desiring desirelessness.
modern: ஒருவர் எதையாவது விரும்ப வேண்டும் என்றால், அவர் மீண்டும் பிறக்காமல் இருக்கும் நிலையையே விரும்ப வேண்டும்; அந்தப் பிறவாமை என்னும் நிலை, ஆசையற்ற தன்மையை (வேண்டாமையை) விரும்புவதால் மட்டுமே உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains that if a person wishes to desire anything at all, the ultimate and only worthy goal is to desire 'non-birth'—the freedom from the cycle of rebirths. The author then reveals how this supreme state is attained: it comes simply by desiring 'desirelessness' itself. By redirecting all our desires toward wanting nothing, we cut off the root cause of rebirth. The clever repetition of the root word 'வேண்டு' (to desire) emphasizes that the path to absolute freedom lies in mastering and redirecting our own desires.
